profile.overview: Yore / Artifice is Vox Mana's four-color without Green expression for civilization, technology, artifice, progress, and engineered agency against natural surrender.
profile.philosophy: Yore believes the given world is not the final world. White structure, Blue optimization, Black refusal, and Red heat can build a machine of agency where Green-rooted acceptance would have asked for surrender.
profile.core_tension: Yore refuses to let natural limits be final, but engineered agency can become overreach when every body, grave, rule, and spark is treated as material to rebuild.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Artifact support, graveyard or reanimation texture, resource conversion, and control through artificial tools can express Yore only when they serve the full four-color without Green worldview of engineered agency against natural limits; mechanics alone do not define the identity.
